title: MD-B01 activation-claim and terminology-claim revalidation
objective: Advance MD-B01 coverage on the locked interpretation rules governing what the platform may claim about itself, testing through the service that makes the claim rather than by reading source.

new_test_file.note: Three of the eight are behavioural: they boot the SQLite harness, seed a genuinely readable publication, and call MarketDataReadinessService, because a freshness claim is made by the readiness payload rather than by a document.

executed_checks.result: is_ready true, activation_state DEVELOPMENT — readiness and freshness reported as separate facts

executed_checks.check: blocked date with no governed marker
executed_checks.result: activation_state DEVELOPMENT on the blocked path too, same vocabulary

executed_checks.check: marker set to the trade date, then to the day after
executed_checks.result: OPERATIONAL on the boundary, DEVELOPMENT before it — the state is derived, not decorative

executed_checks.check: consecutive-SLO vocabulary across app/ and config/, comments stripped
executed_checks.result: zero occurrences on any executable surface
present only as source/detector disclosure; never attached to scope, activation, frontier, or dataset start

executed_checks.check: cross-aliasing among RAW, STRUCTURAL_ADJUSTED, TOTAL_RETURN, PROVIDER_ADJ_CLOSE
executed_checks.result: none; three distinct product constants and the provider payload named as a forbidden canonical basis

executed_checks.result: no alpha, approval, ranking, tradability, conviction, signal, or recommendation vocabulary

executed_checks.result: no surface asserts it as achieved

negative_proof.method: Each mutation applied to a tracked file, verified present before running the guard, guard executed, file restored via git checkout. The verification step exists because MD-B01-A002 recorded a mutation that silently did not apply.

one price product aliased to another

self_correction_during_this_attempt.issue: the decision-grade guard failed on its own test method name
self_correction_during_this_attempt.resolution: renamed the method rather than adding a self-exemption. A carve-out would have weakened the guard for every other file to accommodate one.

self_correction_during_this_attempt.issue: the eligibility vocabulary omitted "signal", one of the four meanings the rule names
self_correction_during_this_attempt.resolution: added before claiming MD-S056-R0126, so the claim covers the full rule text rather than three quarters of it.

self_correction_during_this_attempt.issue: the alias-repetition scan matched only snake_case data_usable and reported 18 non-conforming documents
self_correction_during_this_attempt.resolution: seven of those state the meaning in prose as data-usability, which satisfies the rule as written. Corrected pattern yields 11. The finding was written from the corrected figure.

self_correction_during_this_attempt.issue: this evidence record itself tripped the decision-grade guard: explaining what MD-S056-R0131 forbids used a copula immediately before the term, which the guard reads as an assertion
self_correction_during_this_attempt.resolution: reworded to "qualifies as" rather than weakening the guard or exempting records/evidence from it. Regex cannot reliably parse negation scope, so the discipline is to word records so they do not read as claims — which is the same reason the boundary contract worries about the phrase at all. No fact in this record changed.

self_correction_during_this_attempt.issue: the baseline lock was issued after the analysis and test-authoring phase rather than at attempt start
self_correction_during_this_attempt.resolution: recorded in the lock issuance_note rather than backdated. The authority binding it exists to fix — strategy freeze, epoch, traceability matrix — was unchanged throughout.

newly_satisfied_rules.rule: a development data frontier must never be described as a capability limit or as operational freshness before activation
operational freshness and consecutive SLO claims must begin only from an explicit governed activation boundary
raw source observation, canonical RAW, STRUCTURAL_ADJUSTED, and TOTAL_RETURN must never be treated as interchangeable
eligibility must never be described as alpha approval, candidate ranking, tradability approval, or a trading signal
decision-grade must never be described as an achieved state before the order-22 re-audit

rules_deliberately_not_claimed.reason: Ten frozen strategy contracts use bare `eligible` without repeating the data-usability meaning the rule requires. Not satisfiable by implementation work; raised as F-MD-B01-A003-001.

It forbids one specific inference — that a non-null, in-range, reason-free field qualifies as decision-grade on that basis alone. Proving no code makes that inference reduces to proving no decision-grade claim exists, which is MD-S056-R0130. Claiming both from one body of evidence would double-count it.

test_suite_execution.failing_class_set: identical to MD-B01-A002 and MD-B01-A001; 39 classes, all owned by other stages under F-MD-B00-A001-001

residue_verdict.basis: One test file added, five matrix rows advanced, one finding raised. No runtime code, schema, config, strategy byte, or governance classification changed.

blocking_condition.statement: MD-B01 still cannot reach DONE. 18 of its 127 required rules carry no verifiable predicate.
blocking_condition.not_worked_around: No matrix row was reclassified at this attempt either. The global required set remains exactly 1407.
